params.name: dayUsageHinges

empirical_train.note: total_day_minutes == total_day_charge after z-scoring (max abs diff 5e-4); the two inputs are interchangeable

params.hypothesis: HYPOTHESIS: two ReLU hinges on daytime usage that raise churn for heavy day users, mainly those without a voice-mail plan. total_day_minutes and total_day_charge are identical after z-scoring (max diff 5e-4), so the leaf uses both interchangeably. 1254 = relu(0.42*day - 0.73): on for day z > 1.74 (164 rows, churn 62% vs 12%), logit +2.08 per unit (up to +1.26). 3460 = relu(0.86*day - 0.83*voice_mail_plan - 0.85): on for day z > 0.39 without a voice-mail plan, z > 2.5 with one (995 rows, churn 28% vs 9.5%), logit +2.25 per unit (up to +5.3). EVIDENCE (train, n=4000): closed form above (max err 0.002); sensitivity: 3460 driven by voice_mail_plan (0.21) and day (0.21 total). Combined usage logit (with totalChargeChain): no voice-mail plan, day z>1 and eve z>1 -> +5.2 logit, empirical churn 94%; same usage with a voice-mail plan -> churn 10%. Replacing this leaf by its best linear fit costs 0.008 train AUC; mean-ablating 3460 costs 0.016.

empirical_train.note: eve_charge == eve_minutes after z-scoring; day_charge == day_minutes

params.hypothesis: HYPOTHESIS: a hinge chain on the combined day+evening bill. 5604 = relu(1.14*day_charge + 1.26*eve_charge - 0.94) (eve_charge == eve_minutes after z-scoring) is on for 1143 rows (churn 26%); 4045 = relu(0.60*day_charge + 0.73*5604 - 1.02) sharpens it (626 rows, churn 41% vs 9%), logit +1.57 per unit (up to +7.0). 9871 = relu(0.49*5604 - 0.84) is a higher threshold (244 rows, churn 56%) with a small negative logit weight (-0.24) and a tiny relay path. 387 = relu(0.94 - 1.07*vmail_messages + 0.56*intl_minutes + 0.04*state:1 - 0.86*4045) is on for 76% of rows; its -0.36 output weight lowers churn for customers with few voice-mail messages and many international minutes, and a high bill switches it off (removing that negative term). EVIDENCE: closed form (max err 0.008), sensitivity (4045: eve 0.14, day 0.22; 387: vmail messages 0.81, intl minutes 0.42). Linearising the leaf costs 0.008 AUC; jointly with dayUsageHinges 0.025 (the two overlap: both are day-usage hinges).

params.name: serviceCallsHinges

empirical_train.note: number_customer_service_calls has no direct edge to the output: this leaf is the only route for it, hence the large mean-ablation loss

params.hypothesis: HYPOTHESIS: customer-service-call hinges, with an interaction against day usage: many calls by low-usage customers = churn. 9203 = relu(0.66*cs - 0.67) is on at >=3 calls (848 rows, churn 25%), logit +1.41 per unit. 5395 = relu(0.71*cs - 0.65*day_charge - 0.75) is on at >=4 calls unless day z > ~0.9, or 3 calls with below-average day usage (810 rows), logit +1.93 per unit (up to +6.0). 553 = relu(0.51*cs + 0.28*international_plan - 0.68*state:41 - 0.66): >=1 call with an international plan or >=4 without (555 rows, churn 46%); reaches the logit only via the always-on relay (+0.14 per unit, max +0.45); state:41 rows switch it off (66 rows, effect <= 0.15 logit). EVIDENCE (train): table of this leaf's logit contribution / empirical churn by calls x day z-bin: 4 calls & day z<-1: +3.8 / 95%; 4 calls & day z>1: +0.8 / 33%; 5 calls & day z<-1: +5.6 / 100%; <=2 calls: ~0 / 5-9% (except the high-usage bin, handled by the usage leaves). number_customer_service_calls has no direct edge to the output, so this leaf is its only route: mean-ablating the leaf costs 0.113 train AUC; replacing it by its best linear fit costs 0.021, the largest nonlinear gain of any part.

empirical_train.note: cascade 948->13939/11368->14533->1887 has zero logit effect after mean-ablation (weights -0.09 then -0.015)

params.hypothesis: HYPOTHESIS (revised): rare-state units that are almost inert. 14 hidden nodes driven only by state one-hots (states 50, 23, 22, 1, 28, 32, 44, 12, 2; ~55-105 rows each, large z-values) plus a tiny vmail-messages term. The cascade 3854->13212->8290->948->{13939,11368}->14533->1887 is on for <=105 rows and reaches the output through weights -0.09 then -0.015: zero measurable effect. 1887 (state:28) moves the logit by at most -0.23; 7740 (state:44, always on via bias) by at most +0.40 on state:44 rows; 4332 (state:12) +0.07; 15985 (state:2) +0.02; 3854 (state:32/44) feeds the relay with activation <=0.08. EVIDENCE: closed form (max err 0.022, sympy rounding through the deep cascade); sensitivities all <0.04 except 7740/state:44 (0.98 per unit of activation but output weight 0.05). Mean-ablating the whole leaf changes train AUC by -0.0002; its best linear fit has R2 1.000. The large per-state effects in this network are in the root's direct linear edges, not here.

params.name: churnModelRoot
params.hypothesis: HYPOTHESIS: churn logit = -2.00 + linear term (direct edges) + dayUsageHinges + totalChargeChain + serviceCallsHinges + rareStateUnits + an always-on affine relay; output = sigmoid. Additive (parallel) composition at the output, plus a serial path: 553 (serviceCalls), 9871 (charge) and 3854 (states) feed the relay 12977/2377 -> 5868 -> 7162 -> output, which is active on all 4000 training rows and so contributes a constant (about -1.28) plus small linear terms. Linear term: international_plan +0.77/SD (+2.67 logit for plan holders), voice_mail_plan -0.86/SD (-2.37 for holders), vmail messages +0.41, intl minutes +0.45, eve minutes +0.22, night charge +0.22, account_length +0.12, and 17 per-state offsets (largest: state:46 -1.89, state:4 +1.48, state:47 +1.22, state:31 +0.86, state:0 -0.82, state:50 -0.76 logit on their 41-90 rows). 33 inputs are unconnected (zero effect). EVIDENCE (train, local mean-ablation and linearisation): full AUC 0.910; all hidden parts mean-ablated (direct edges only) 0.717; all hidden parts replaced by their best joint linear fit 0.835 (cf. L2 logistic regression train 0.843). So the nonlinear gain over a linear model is ~0.07 AUC, from service-call hinges with the low-usage interaction (0.021 alone) and the day/total-charge hinges with the voice-mail-plan gate (0.025 jointly), plus synergy between them (joint linearisation 0.074). rareStateUnits and the relay contribute ~0.
